prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a refined, richly illustrated transparent triptych for an academic researcher's website. This is a finished illustration study, with craft and visual richness comparable to hand-painted strategy/RPG key art.
Primary requirement: the three subjects must be immediately recognizable as COURSES, RESEARCH PUBLICATIONS and A RESEARCH TEAM, while being beautifully detailed and sophisticated.

Art direction: polished semi-realistic hand-painted digital illustration, dimensional lighting, beautifully observed materials, crisp intentional detail, confident painterly finish. Mature editorial / premium game inventory illustration. Deep indigo, petroleum teal, warm oxblood, copper, parchment ivory and a few saffron accents; nuanced rich color variation, warm reflected light and cool shadows. Real paper fibers, individually separated page edges, fine cloth stitching, brushed metal highlights and wood grain. Every object should feel thoughtfully designed. Avoid flat corporate clipart, big featureless plastic surfaces, generic emoji, faceless clay people, chunky simplistic shapes, childish cartoon proportions or excessive fantasy ornament.

LEFT / COURSES: a substantial open academic notebook with an indigo cloth hard cover and subtle copper corner fittings, realistically layered cream pages, two differently colored page tabs, and a warm oxblood ribbon bookmark. Its pages show beautifully composed blue-ink mathematical diagrams: a clear small connected-node graph and a curved coordinate plot, together with orderly thin abstract manuscript lines, no legible words. A fine wood pencil with a copper ferrule rests naturally along the notebook's lower edge. Book remains the dominant silhouette.

CENTER / RESEARCH: a small overlapping stack of actual scholarly papers with a clipped corner and thoughtful editorial layout, blue and teal small line charts, a compact diagram of connected nodes, and fine abstract text lines (no legible text). An elegant copper-rimmed magnifying glass with a dark oxblood handle lies diagonally across the papers, visibly enlarging part of the diagram. One slim fountain pen and a small paper binder clip complete this restrained still life. Layered paper, precise ink marks, reflections in the lens and dimensional shadows convey serious research rather than a generic search button.

RIGHT / RESEARCH LAB TEAM: a compact exquisitely detailed miniature research meeting vignette: three young adult researchers in ordinary refined casual academic clothes, naturally proportioned heads and recognizable faces, one woman with tied hair, one man with glasses and another researcher, collaboratively leaning around a walnut desk with a realistic open laptop and a few neatly arranged papers. One researcher points at a small freestanding whiteboard behind them with a coherent simple node graph and two small curves; another is taking notes. Warm teamwork and intellectual discussion, nuanced expressive poses. They are people working together, not pawns, dolls, faceless figures or a chemistry lab. A single small plant can balance the composition. Keep the complete vignette compact and legible; no enclosing room or walls.

Composition: exactly THREE standalone evenly spaced object groups in ONE horizontal row on a wide 3:1 canvas. Each subject completely inside its own third with transparent margins and clear transparent gaps between groups. Unified three-quarter perspective and light source. Similar visual weight; the book, papers/magnifier and team/desk silhouettes should each read clearly before the fine details.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside objects, no backdrop rectangle, room, floor plane, haze, glow, paper splatter, checkerboard, halo, typography, labels, logos or watermark. Delicate local contact shadows only, clean cutout boundaries.
